runnerRegression.changes: Select .test.mjs when that is the declared entry; retain exact prior .test.ts config otherwise. Receipt-bound generated-config verification retained. Generic disclaimer no longer calls all capsules pure-function.

contracts.packaging: Full builder body read, including pre/post pack/sign hooks, explicit resources and unpacked entries, per-platform targets, rebuild and nested signing. Nested helpers beyond named full reads remain partial.
contracts.executionEligibility: Daemon/CLI execution probes are gated by architecture only (host match or universal), not host platform; Windows PTY verifier additionally requires win32 host. Cross-arch source existence is not a runtime pass. No cross-platform build performed.
contracts.daemonProbe: Checks entry presence, spawn error, missing-module stderr and usage stderr; does not explicitly validate status/signal separately. Original tests use short synthetic Node entries, not real service.
contracts.cliClosure: LIFO pending.pop traversal, not BFS. Finds literal require/require.resolve/dynamic import calls, not complete JS module analysis. Optional dependency resolution may skip absent imports. runCli clears NODE_PATH and deletes ORCA_CLI_CWD, but inherits other environment values; not hermetic.
contracts.preview: Writer uses explicit ORCA_LOCAL_PREVIEW_BUILD=1; reader caches absent/preview/unusable. Only ENOENT means absent for an attempted file read; bad JSON/schema and other read errors are unusable and block preview updates. Numeric formatVersion is not pinned to1 by reader.
contracts.mentu: Lock fixes executable revision/digest and platform/arch. Packaging strips workspace Mentu state and verifies approved resource before and after signing. Provision removes destination before rename: not atomic replacement/fsync durable. These packaging restrictions do not establish upstream Mentu limitations.
contracts.authority: Independent Drogon app identity, owned release/signing resources and endpoints required; no copying old credentials, running source publishing hooks or installing over personal Orca. Preserve attribution.

remaining: M3 runtime dependency closure, M4 glibc ELF details, M9 AppImage verifier, native/plugin/PTY helper remainder and CI jobs still require coordinator review.

Builder-config and Mentu packaging test bodies read but NOT executed: builder imports real dependency closure and Mentu test requires locked binary; do not fake missing runtime or dependencies and call that original baseline.
Actual packages on macOS/Linux/Windows, signing/update/rollback, source-to-candidate test ports and installed preview acceptance remain open.
Preview reader/writer unit baselines do not prove every updater entrypoint is fenced.
